name: Dragon Flag
steps: Lie flat on a sturdy bench and reach overhead to grip the bench edges firmly behind your head.
Brace your lats and abs, then lift your hips and straight legs vertically until your weight balances across your upper back.
Keep your glutes squeezed and body completely rigid as you lower your straight torso and legs slowly toward the bench.
Stop just before your hips touch down, then drive your rigid body smoothly back up to the vertical position.
tips: Move your shoulders, hips, and legs as one straight rigid plank rather than bending sharply at your hips.
Keep your head and neck relaxed on the bench by supporting your weight across your upper back and shoulders.
